components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default decisive action with ink background and immediate pressed feedback.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 6px; background: #15181c; color: #ffffff; font: 500 0.8125rem/1.25rem Inter, sans-serif; transition: transform 100ms ease-out, background-color 100ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: rgb(21 24 28 / 0.9); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px) scale(0.985); background: rgb(21 24 28 / 0.8); }

components.name: Accent Button
components.description: Sparse Swiss red action button for rare high-priority moments.
components.css: .ds-btn-accent { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 6px; background: #da291c; color: #ffffff; font: 500 0.8125rem/1.25rem Inter, sans-serif; transition: transform 100ms ease-out, background-color 100ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-accent:hover, .ds-btn-accent:active { background: #b01f15; } .ds-btn-accent:active { transform: translateY(1px) scale(0.985); }

components.name: Product Card
components.description: Flat product grid card with stable image, title, spec, and price zones.
components.css: .ds-product-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; width: 100%; height: 100%; border-radius: 10px; color: #15181c; text-decoration: none; } .ds-product-image { aspect-ratio: 1; border-radius: 10px; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #e2e4e7; background: #f5f6f7; } .ds-product-card:hover .ds-product-image { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #cbcfd4; } .ds-product-card:active .ds-product-image { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #15181c; }

components.name: Input
components.description: Flat paper field with hairline border and red focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; font: 500 0.8125rem/1.25rem Inter, sans-serif; color: #15181c; } .ds-field input { height: 44px; border: 1px solid #e2e4e7; border-radius: 6px; background: #ffffff; padding: 0 12px; color: #15181c; font-size: 16px; } .ds-field input:hover { border-color: #cbcfd4; } .ds-field input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #da291c; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #ffffff, 0 0 0 4px #da291c; }

narrative.overview: Valy's storefront should feel like reliable home infrastructure: organized, plain-spoken, and calm enough to make technical buying feel manageable. The Apple-like reference is restraint and precision, not theatrical minimalism. The system is calm technical retail: flat, neutral, precise, and responsive.
keyCharacteristics: Technical detail made readable through tables, specs, and stable grids.
Red as a rare brand/action accent.
Immediate pressed states on every interactive surface.

rules.name: The Red Rarity Rule
rules.body: Swiss red is most effective when it is scarce. Do not tint whole layouts red or use it to decorate ordinary cards.

rules.name: The Flat Commerce Rule
rules.body: Product cards, specs, account panels, and checkout surfaces sit flat at rest. Use a border before a shadow.

rules.name: The Data Mono Rule
rules.body: Use the mono font for values that are scanned or compared, not for mood.

dos: Do keep most screens neutral, flat, and bordered.
Do use Swiss red for focus, selection, and rare high-priority actions.
Do preserve immediate active states on touch and pointer controls.
Do align product-card baselines and reserve room for dynamic catalogue data.
donts: Don't use blue as the brand accent.
Don't make red a page-wide theme or decorative wash.
Don't use location as a brand proof point.
Don't add heavy card shadows to ordinary commerce surfaces.
